lines.speaker: Aleksandra
lines.text: Piter! Help me!

lines.speaker: Malachor
lines.text: Your sister carries a light that belongs to me!

lines.speaker: Piter
lines.text: I will not let you hurt her. I am coming for you, Aleksandra!

lines.speaker: Forest Spirit
lines.text: Follow the silver leaves. The shadows cannot see their glow.

lines.speaker: Piter
lines.text: This forest hides more than goblins.

lines.speaker: Royal Guard
lines.text: Malachor has raised the soldiers of old.

lines.speaker: Piter
lines.text: Their curse ends today.

lines.speaker: Aleksandra
lines.text: Piter... if you can hear me, do not give up.

lines.speaker: Piter
lines.text: I hear you! I am coming!

lines.speaker: Piter
lines.text: The map shows a castle on the hill.

lines.speaker: Aleksandra
lines.text: Look for the sun symbol by the old bridge.

lines.speaker: Gate Guardian
lines.text: No human will pass through this gate!

lines.speaker: Piter
lines.text: Then a brother will.

lines.speaker: Piter
lines.text: I do not have to kill you, dragon. Go in peace.

lines.speaker: Young Dragon
lines.text: Grrrr...

lines.speaker: Piter
lines.text: Thank you for showing me the passage.

lines.speaker: Forest Spirit
lines.text: Three seals will weaken Malachor’s spell.

lines.speaker: Piter
lines.text: I will carry them to the tower.

lines.speaker: Aleksandra
lines.text: Piter! The barrier is too strong!

lines.speaker: Piter
lines.text: Hold on. I will destroy the crystals.

lines.speaker: Malachor
lines.text: Aleksandra’s light will power my greatest spell!

lines.speaker: Piter
lines.text: You will never abduct anyone again.

lines.speaker: Aleksandra
lines.text: I knew you would come for me.

lines.speaker: Piter
lines.text: Always. Let’s go home.
